itinerary.title: Arrival in Paradise
itinerary.description: Welcome to Boracay! Airport pickup and scenic boat transfer to the island. Check into your beachfront resort and enjoy a welcome dinner with traditional Filipino cuisine and cultural show.

itinerary.title: White Beach Exploration
itinerary.description: Start your day with a delicious breakfast buffet overlooking the crystal-clear waters. Spend the morning relaxing on the famous White Beach, known for its powdery white sand. Afternoon island orientation and optional water sports.

itinerary.title: Island Hopping Adventure
itinerary.description: Full-day island hopping tour visiting Puka Beach, Crocodile Island, and Magic Island. Enjoy snorkeling in pristine waters, cliff jumping, and a delicious seafood lunch on the boat. Return to resort for sunset viewing.

itinerary.title: Sunset Sailing & Free Time
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure to explore the island or relax at the resort. Afternoon sunset sailing experience on a traditional paraw boat. Evening free time to enjoy Boracay's vibrant nightlife and shopping.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Final breakfast at the resort and check-out. Transfer to the pier for boat ride back to mainland, then to the airport for your departure flight. Take home unforgettable memories of paradise!

tourDescription: Discover the world-famous Boracay Island with our exclusive 5-day adventure package. Experience pristine white sand beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and vibrant island culture. This comprehensive tour includes luxury beachfront accommodation, exciting island hopping, sunset sailing, and authentic Filipino experiences that will create memories to last a lifetime.
